name: Food enzymes
aliases: enzymes, food enzymes, rennet, pepsin, amylase, lactase, lipase, proteases, enzimas
what_is: Proteins that act as catalysts to accelerate chemical reactions in food processing.
why_botia: It flags them because enzymes like rennet or lipase can be extracted from animal stomachs, microbial cultures, or genetically modified organisms, creating major halal and vegetarian concerns.
can_1: Identify generic or specific enzyme declarations on a label.
can_2: Highlight potential animal origin and activate religious choice layers.
cannot_1: Determine whether the enzyme was sourced from a microbial fermentation, a plant, or an animal tissue.
cannot_2: Verify if the enzyme remains active or has been completely denatured/inactivated in the final food product.
title: Food enzymes
description: Proteins that act as catalysts to accelerate chemical reactions in food processing.
